Tests/commands were read, not run by this packet.

It is not F03, not any canonical-family result, not ledger truth, and not Preview/Preprod. Historical never-run comments do not override that later narrow receipt.

UNLOCATED means only that the recorded literal ID/name search in S01 (experiments/moriarty-cardano-rust, *.rs/*.mori/*.json/*.md) found no explicit family association. It is not unsupported, not a compatibility verdict, and not a whole-language percentage or 20/20 validation.
